The latest release notes that cover Muse Glimmer (through v0.32.15) state that it can be run on:

* **Apple Silicon** – initial MLX‑engine support (v0.32.7)  
* **NVIDIA GPUs** – added in v0.32.8  
* **AMD GPUs** – added in v0.32.8  
* **All other platforms** – the release notes say the model is now available on “all platforms” (v0.32.8)

> “Muse Glimmer is now available on all platforms.” [ollama/v0.32.8.md]  
> “Add Muse Glimmer support for NVIDIA, AMD, and additional platforms.” [ollama/v0.32.8.md]  
> “Note: Muse Glimmer is currently available via initial support via Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon.” [ollama/v0.32.7.md]
